product_one_liner.value: On3 Works uses proprietary AI and engineer-led vetting to source, screen and shortlist developers, engineers and IT specialists for companies hiring in the United Kingdom and Spain.

named_customers.notes: Banco Mediolanum and Kubide Tech Builder are named as early clients in a January 2023 founder statement; CGI has a current public testimonial.

hq_location.notes: The company profile lists London as headquarters; the official About page instead describes its remote-first headquarters as Mallorca, Spain, without identifying a single headquarters city.

eng_blog.notes: The index is primarily hiring research, comparisons and guides, with one implementation-focused AI-pipeline article; it does not establish two posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation or help-center link appears in the navigation or footer; the site provides a single homepage FAQ rather than a multi-article documentation portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No public company careers page or internal job board was found; client recruitment specialties are not evidence of internal vacancies.

model_provider.notes: The AI-pipeline article describes proprietary AI, vector embeddings and a fine-tuned LLM but does not name an underlying model or provider. No public product documentation, security/privacy FAQ or subprocessor list was found.

compliance_certs.notes: No public security, trust or legal page or certification-badge area was located; no supported certification claim was found.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile, updated April 19, 2026, reports no funding rounds; the founder also described the company as bootstrapped with no external funding. No round date or amount applies.

raised_18mo.notes: No outside funding is reported. The funding database was last updated April 19, 2026; no later funding announcement was found for the window May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No public company careers page or internal job board was found; historical SDR employment does not establish a current opening.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest dated launch-type item found is the April 13, 2026 announcement of the Hosteleria Mallorca division, before May 9, 2026. Later readable posts concern research or media appearances, not a product or major-feature launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small About-page leadership roster consists of the founders, including John Kinloch as CEO, and dates the company’s founding to 2022; no C-level or VP join or departure within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 was found.
